summary: Read a table of integers with at least one row and at least one column. Start at the top-left cell and walk clockwise, ring after ring, toward the center. Pass each cell once until every cell has been passed. Write the integers in the order of those visits. A table that has only one row or only one column is a straight walk along that line. Do not skip a cell and do not pass a cell twice.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
